summary: Veritone, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 20,000,000 common shares at $0.75 per share, a 37% discount to the $1.19 September 30, 2026 Nasdaq close, raising $15.0 million gross and $14.1 million net of placement agent fees. Needham & Company and A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners serve as placement agents, receiving $0.045 per share. Closing is expected on or about October 2, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and trading pressure against VERI's thin price.
